product_overview: Nubra Trade Replay is a Streamlit app that helps users review completed F&O trades using either built-in synthetic personas or an uploaded CSV tradebook. It summarizes performance, highlights evidence-backed behavioral patterns, and lets users commit to a next-month habit rule with a downloadable action plan.
core_goals: Select a sample trader persona or upload a completed tradebook CSV to begin analysis
Review portfolio performance metrics for completed trades
Inspect ranked, evidence-backed trade findings with supporting trade-level evidence
Explore trade activity through daily breakdown and completed trade logs with filters
Choose a habit rule and download a 30-day action plan

features.name: Data Source Selection
features.description: Users can start a review by choosing a synthetic sample trader persona or uploading their own completed tradebook CSV.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select the synthetic sample trader data source -> Choose a persona from the available options -> See the dashboard load with analysis results
Navigate to / -> Select the completed tradebook CSV upload data source -> Upload a custom tradebook CSV file -> See the dashboard load with analysis results

features.name: Portfolio Performance Overview
features.description: Users can quickly review key portfolio summary metrics for the selected tradebook.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> View the top-level performance metric cards -> See net P&L, win rate, completed trade count, average P&L, and charges summarized on the dashboard

features.name: Evidence-Backed Pattern Findings
features.description: Users can review up to three ranked findings that explain notable trade behaviors, with supporting evidence and checklist-based evaluation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> View the ranked finding cards with safety caveats -> Expand a finding's evidence section -> Inspect the qualifying trades and calculations that support the finding -> Expand the evaluated checklist -> Review the three behavioral checks used to assess the pattern
Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset that does not trigger a pattern -> View the dashboard findings area -> See that no qualifying finding is surfaced

features.name: Tradebook and Activity Explorer
features.description: Users can inspect the tradebook through daily pacing and completed trade log views, then narrow results with outcome and expiry filters.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> Switch to the daily breakdown and pacing view -> Review the activity summary by day
Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> Switch to the completed trade log view -> Filter by outcome -> Filter by expiry type -> Review the matching trades in the log

Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> Switch to the completed trade log view -> Filter by a specific outcome -> Filter by a specific expiry category -> Observe the log update to show only matching trades

features.name: Next-Month Habit Commitment
features.description: Users can select a recommended rule, commit to monitoring it next month, and download a markdown action plan.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> Select a recommended rule from the list -> Commit to monitoring the rule next month -> See the commitment recorded in the session
Navigate to / -> Load a trader dataset -> Select a recommended rule from the list -> Download the 30-day action plan in markdown format -> Save the action plan locally

routes.description: Main dashboard for Nubra Trade Replay

features.name: Data Source Selection
features.description: Switch between synthetic personas (A, B, C, D, E) and custom CSV upload
user_interactions: Select data source radio button (Synthetic Sample Trader or Upload Completed Tradebook CSV)
Select persona from dropdown in sidebar
Upload custom tradebook CSV file via file uploader

features.name: Portfolio Performance Overview
features.description: Display summary KPI metrics including net P&L, win rate, completed trade count, avg P&L, and charges
user_interactions: View metric cards at the top of the dashboard

features.name: Evidence-Backed Pattern Findings
features.description: Surface up to 3 ranked findings with expandable evidence tables and evaluated pattern checklist
user_interactions: View finding cards with safety caveats
Expand evidence table expanders to inspect qualifying trades and calculations
Expand evaluated pattern checklist to view all 3 behavioral checks

features.name: Tradebook and Activity Explorer
features.description: Interactive explorer with tabs for daily breakdown and completed trade log with outcome and expiry filters
user_interactions: Switch between Daily Breakdown & Pacing tab and Completed Trade Log tab
Select filter by outcome dropdown (All, Winning, Losing)
Select filter by expiry dropdown (All, Expiry Days, Non-Expiry Days)

features.name: Next-Month Habit Commitment
features.description: Habit rule recommendation and commitment selection with Markdown action plan download
user_interactions: Click Commit to Monitoring This Rule Next Month button

known_limitations.impact: Habit commitments and uploaded tradebooks are stored in Streamlit browser memory and reset on refresh or dataset switch
Overnight positions and short-first options are not supported in the prototype
